title: Dajé - Down
htmlContent:
Florida singer-songwriter Dajé releases a new single titled "Down". With seductive musical stylings that weave reggae, dancehall, R&B, hip-hop and her Haitian heritage pop style known as Kompa, this multi-layered sensation brings a much-needed breath of fresh air to popular music.

The single "Down" is a follow-up of Dajé singles "Avec Moi" and "Bon Feeling". This is one of those special tunes, that so many good thoughts rush to you, that it’s hard to pick one good thing to say. It’s nothing short of exemplary with a big time sound that transcends cultures. The production is amazing at creating an engaging abstract tone that’s captivating, and sets the tone for the magic the vocals create to delivery the writing in it’s purest form.
